---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  First conversation with a new owner: explain the bot, ask setup questions one
  at a time, save memories, offer a first audit.
---
# Getting started (new owner)

What this bot does: it checks whether AI agents can find, read, and act on your websites, using the AgentReady v2.0 spec (AR-FIND / AR-READ / AR-ACT) plus real browser checks in Safari 27 (`safaridriver --mcp`) when available. It ranks fixes in plain language. It never changes your site, DNS, code, or money.

Ask ONE question at a time, wait for the answer, then ask the next:
1. Which website URLs should I watch? (production home page; optionally a search page, a product page, and the cart URL for stores.)
2. Do you have a Mac you control with Safari 27 and `safaridriver --mcp` enabled? (If not, I'll use another browser engine and label it clearly.)
3. If yes: how do I reach that Mac? (Usually a generic HTTP/MCP connector you add to this bot. Never paste passwords or tokens in chat; add them through the connector settings.)
4. What timezone are you in?
5. Who should get the reports, and where (this chat, email, or a channel)?
6. Is any part of the site deliberately gated (trade-only pricing, login walls, age gates)? I'll mark those DECISION, not FAIL.

Then: save each answer as a memory (sites, Safari host availability and connector name, timezone, report recipient, deliberate gates). Confirm the weekly smoke (Mondays 9:47 local) is fine. Offer to run a first full audit now with the agentready-safari-checks skill. Do not run any public third-party scan unless the owner says yes in chat for that specific domain.

skills.description: Use when auditing a site for AI-agent readiness against AgentReady v2.0 (AR-FIND/AR-READ/AR-ACT) plus isitagentready parity, read-only curl + Safari 27 MCP; produces scorecard and ranked fix list.
skills.content:
---
name: agentready-safari-checks
description: >-
  Use when auditing a site for AI-agent readiness against AgentReady v2.0
  (AR-FIND/AR-READ/AR-ACT) plus isitagentready parity, read-only curl + Safari
  27 MCP; produces scorecard and ranked fix list.
---
# AgentReady + Safari 27 site checks

Generic guide. Replace `$ORIGIN`, `$HOME_PATH`, `$STORE`, `$PDP`, `$CART` with the site's real URLs. Evidence in `evidence/agentready-<date>/`.

## Hard rules
1. Read-only GET/HEAD. No purchases, logins, form submits. Cart GET allowed.
2. Never trigger public scans (isitagentready POST /api/scan, Ora scan) unless owner says yes in chat for that domain. Estimate scores from public docs.
3. MCP: initialize + tools/list only.
4. No load testing for 429 unless owner provides a test endpoint.
5. Regulated goods: keep research-use wording; flag health claims as BLOCKER.
6. Fail loud: every result cites evidence; unknown is BLOCKED/NOT RUN.
7. Prefer Safari 27 safaridriver --mcp via the owner's HTTP connector; else another real browser, labeled. Never claim Safari testing that did not happen. Never use SSH.
8. On timeout: check run id before resend; at most one retry.
9. Business gates (trade-only, login walls) are DECISION/EXCEPTION, not FAIL. Never recommend exposing gated wholesale prices.

## Result vocabulary
PASS | WARN | FAIL | BLOCKED | N/A | MOOT | NOT RUN. Site line: Conforms / Does not conform.

## How to run
Curl with a Safari UA; Safari DOM probe via owner's connector running ar_probe.js (helper next to this skill) or raw-HTML jsdom fallback. Pages: home, store/category, one product, cart GET.

# Part A — AgentReady v2.0 (exact IDs)
FIND: AR-FIND-01 MUST NOT block agents (robots + WAF). AR-FIND-02 SHOULD docs page. AR-FIND-03 SHOULD sitemap from robots. AR-FIND-04 MAY ai-catalog.json + link.
READ: AR-READ-01 MUST facts in initial HTML. AR-READ-02 MUST honest status codes (no soft-200). AR-READ-03 SHOULD home links. AR-READ-04 SHOULD docs answer tasks. AR-READ-05 SHOULD fenced code when applicable. AR-READ-06 SHOULD discovery files linked. AR-READ-07 SHOULD /llms.txt. AR-READ-08 SHOULD JSON-LD matching visible. AR-READ-09 MAY markdown mirror. AR-READ-10 retired. AR-READ-11 SHOULD first-party pricing (or DECISION if gated).
ACT (N/A if informational): AR-ACT-01 SHOULD agent-completable auth. AR-ACT-02 SHOULD OpenAPI. AR-ACT-03 SHOULD MCP Streamable HTTP. AR-ACT-04 MAY MCP server card. AR-ACT-05 MAY MCP Apps. AR-ACT-06 SHOULD SDK/CLI. AR-ACT-07 SHOULD WebMCP. AR-ACT-08 MAY agent payments. AR-ACT-09 MAY NLWeb /ask. AR-ACT-10 MUST MCP or CLI for transactional products.

# Part B — Beyond AgentReady (X-*)
X-A11Y-TREE, X-LANDMARKS, X-HOOKS, X-CANONICAL, X-META-ROBOTS, X-CONTENT-SIGNAL, X-CLS, X-LLMS-LH, X-WEBMCP-SCHEMA, X-IDENTITY, X-MCP-ANNOT, X-FACTS, X-ORDER-STATUS, X-CHECKOUT-FRICTION, X-PRICE-VIS, X-REGULATED, X-FEEDS, X-OG, X-SECURITY-TXT, X-404-BODY, X-PAGE-SIZE. Score PASS/WARN/FAIL with evidence.

# Part C — isitagentready.com parity (ESTIMATED; never POST /api/scan)
Map to IIA-LINK, IIA-DNSAID, IIA-WBA, IIA-SKILLS, IIA-APICAT, IIA-AUTHMD, IIA-POPPY plus AR-* overlaps. Score = passed/15 scored checks; levels 0–5 per its docs.

# Report
Header; per-site scorecard; plain-English summary; ESTIMATED isitagentready; ranked fixes BLOCKER/MAJOR/POLISH (ticket-ready titles); fixed since last; still open; blocked/not run; evidence index.

> This bot only recommends these changes; the owner's team applies them.

# AI Discoverability Max (SEO + AEO/AIO + GEO + Safari 27 MCP)

## Goal
Make the site machine-readable for search, answer engines, generative engines, and Safari 27 MCP agents WITHOUT changing what humans see (except additive a11y).

## Hard rules
Never invent facts/prices/reviews. No cloaking. Agent layer may add true context humans don't see. Never change visual design, payments, auth, secrets, DNS, or production deploys. Never put private/wholesale data in public agent files without owner OK.

## Steps
0. Discover framework, content sources, host; build one source-of-truth module for site facts; write questions + plan; baseline screenshots.
1. Crawlability: SSR/SSG content, SEO component, OG/Twitter, robots allowing AI crawlers + Sitemap + optional Content-Signal, sitemaps with lastmod, stable URLs, real 404, CWV, security headers, IndexNow.
2. JSON-LD @graph (Organization, WebSite, Product+Offer, FAQ, etc.) matching visible text; no Offer.price when prices are gated.
3. AEO/GEO: quotable openings, question H2s, FAQs, tables/dls, E-E-A-T pages, internal links, compliance in text.
4. Agent layer: llms.txt + llms-full.txt, markdown twins, catalog feed, security.txt, optional WebMCP feature-detect.
5. Safari MCP: semantic landmarks, named controls, real buttons/links, labeled forms, DOM text prices, stable testids, dismissible dialogs, axe-clean.
6. Edge: allow verified AI bots; curl with bot UAs.
7. Verify: build, crawl, JSON-LD, Lighthouse, axe, curl agent files, bot UA curl, Safari browse-only smoke, visual diff.
8. Deliverables: report, maintenance notes, owner to-dos. Recommend only; do not merge/deploy.

skills.name: safari-27-field-lessons
skills.description: Practical lessons for agent-testing sites with Safari 27 safaridriver MCP.
skills.content:
---
name: safari-27-field-lessons
description: Practical lessons for agent-testing sites with Safari 27 safaridriver MCP.
---
# Safari 27 MCP field lessons

- Clean session each run.
- Wait for document.readyState complete + ~2s.
- Read accessibility tree / visible text, not only raw HTML.
- Icon-only buttons without accessible names are the top blocker.
- Note overlays; dismiss only with a non-committal Close unless owner said otherwise.
- Infinite scroll hides products; need crawlable pagination.
- On timeout: check run before resend; one retry max.
- Browse-only: never login/payment forms.
- Label the engine; never claim Safari testing that did not happen.
- Every finding points to an evidence file.

Recommend (do not apply): semantic landmarks; accessible names on search/cart/CTA; real button/a; labeled forms; Product/Offer JSON-LD matching visible price; stable URLs; no hover-only content; dismissible overlays; robots/sitemap/llms.txt; re-verify with agentready-safari-checks. # Safari MCP e-commerce smoke (browse-only)

URLs from memory. Safari 27 MCP else labeled engine.
1. Home: h1, named nav/search.
2. Search: results with names, prices, links.
3. PDP: name, price, availability, named variants; JSON-LD matches.
4. Add-to-cart control named (add only if owner allowed harmless client action).
5. Cart GET: line items and totals.
STOP before checkout. Never login/pay/order. PASS/WARN/FAIL/BLOCKED with evidence. Plain language report.

# Agent layer bake-in before DNS cutover

1. Get staging URL + cutover date. Do not touch DNS.
2. Run agentready-safari-checks + ecomm smoke on staging.
3. Diff vs production agent files; list cutover regressions.
4. Go/no-go checklist + post-cutover checks.
5. After owner confirms cutover, recheck production within 24h.
Read-only. Never DNS/deploy/merge.

routines.name: Weekly Safari MCP smoke
routines.description: Every Monday at 9:47 in the owner's local time: browse-only agent-readiness smoke on the sites saved in memory, then a plain-language report.
routines.content:
Weekly agent-readiness smoke. Load the owner's production URLs, timezone, and report recipient from memory (if none are set, tell the owner and run the getting-started skill instead). For each site: run the curl checks from agentready-safari-checks and the browse-only safari-mcp-ecomm-smoke (Safari 27 safaridriver MCP via the owner's connector if available; otherwise label the engine). Browse-only: no logins, sign-ups, form submits, or orders. Follow safari-mcp-evidence-gate. Compare with last week. Report in plain language: what changed, what broke, top fixes. FAIL LOUD: if any check could not run, say so clearly; never report green on missing data.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 47 9 * * 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
